synthesis:draft.headline: Other-region AEMO market notices did not verbatim report an SA1 “price spike”; they reported inter-regional constraint sets or local equipment notices that reference the V‑SA interconnector or unrelated local events.

document_statements.paraphrase: A VIC inter-regional transfer notice reports a short‑notice outage of South Morang‑Sydenham No.1 500 kV line and states that the invoked constraint set contains equations with interconnectors including V‑SA [market_notice_144694#0].
A VIC notice states AEMO invoked automated constraint set CA_SYDS_597B5710, and that this constraint set contains equations with interconnector V‑SA [market_notice_144688#0].

A NSW inter‑regional transfer notice reports that the planned outage of Directlink all 3 cables was completed and that Directlink returned to service at 14:30 NEM time on 31/07/2026 (1430 hrs 31/07/2026) with associated constraint set(s) revoked [market_notice_144695#0].

A QLD non‑conformance notice declares unit LILYSF1 non‑conforming for 29/07/2026 12:40–12:45 and reports the amount as 56 MW; the notice text does not state an SA1 price spike [market_notice_144689#0].
